title: Best Bike Tour in Barcelona! Brendan was a fantastic tour guide. We had so much fun and it was a highlight of our trip.
text: Our tour guide Brendan was the best! We loved the fact that it was a private tour and he was a great guide that helped us discover this beautiful city. He felt like a longtime friend giving you the insiders guide to the best treasures of the city. We enjoyed floored for E-bikes which made it easy to pedal through the streets. We winded through old historic neighborhoods, had some delicious cheeses and Iberian ham at the market and enjoyed tapas at a local restaurant. author: Katherine J

title: Highly recommend, the best experience in Barcelona.
text: One of the best experiences you can do in Barcelona. We had such an amazing time with Brendan, we not only had amazing food but were able to cycle all over the city and see some amazing vantage points. We especially loved the tapas meal at the end in a local family restaurant with local drinks. Brendan is so welcoming that he feels more like a friend than a guide.
author: seadreamsmb

title: Best bike and food tour ever!
text:
My partner and I found this tour by recommendation from a family member. We are so glad we decided to do it. It was the best tour we were on in Barcelona and was the highlight of our trip. 

Brendon was a great, personable tour guide who was very knowledgeable about the area. He took us to many spots that we would not have known to go to. The food, views, and company were  amazing. 

I recommend booking this tour.
author: callai2024

title: A great bike tour of the city with visits to places the guidebooks didn’t talk about. Sign up if you have the time!
text: The tour was awesome! Brandon took the time show us parts of the city the tour books don’t mention. It was easy to ride through the city. Definitely 5 stars!
author: markkY3652OM

title: Best Bike Tour Ever!
text:
Brendan is easily the best guide we have had, and my wife and I have done many guided tours over several years and countries. His knowledge of Barcelona is incredible, and he continues to expand that knowledge with trips to surrounding areas and his ritual use of the library.
Brendan created a tour for my wife and I when we casually mentioned on the food tour we were currently on, that we couldn't find a bike tour through Barcelona that would allow us to book as just two people. The requirement was four or more.
